title: Retry failed deliveries
description: Retries must not duplicate a completed delivery.
diff:
diff --git a/worker.py b/worker.py
--- a/worker.py
+++ b/worker.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 def deliver(job):
+    send(job.payload)
     mark_complete(job)

gold_findings.summary: A retry can send the payload twice.

behavioral_check.expected: The regression test fails before the fix and passes after the fix.
